ValidationRule.description: Orders cannot be cancelled if the status is In progress or Results ready.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Cancelled'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'PWN Rejected') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Partial Results Ready'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Results Ready'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'In Progress') ), TEXT(Cancel_Reason__c)!='TNP' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Fulfillment Order cannot be cancelled at this stage.
